thread:
nihal: FYI the release gate tripped for pipeline #3567. 'multipart-verify' failed during artifact download on staging and deploybot auto-paused promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for commit pqr789stu due to 'multipart-verify' failure on runner staging-09. Error: checksum mismatch for chunk 3 (expected sha256: 9f8e..., got: 1a2b...). Auto-retries exhausted (3/3).

cory: that smells like a bad multipart reassemble or a client-side truncated chunk. Any builder cache we can pull from?

nihal: logs show the client upload exited 0 but S3 reports the composed object checksum mismatch when streamed. here's the snippet:
```
Verifying chunk 3/7: expected sha256=9f8e6d... actual=1a2b3c...
Aborting assemble: checksum mismatch
```
nihal: the canonical copy in releases/v1.7.0 exists and looks good (sha256 verified). Could be a bad compose during finalization or an intermediate proxy corruption.

shera: given the 30m change window left, I'd avoid force-promote. Two mitigation paths: A) reassemble/reupload from builder cache and retry (fast), B) pin to v1.7.0 and schedule a clean rebuild tomorrow (safe). Which can we complete fastest?

cory: reassemble should be ~10m if cache present. I'll check builder /var/build/cache/3567/shards. If part 3 is corrupted locally too then we need a clean rebuild.

nihal: please paste the exact reupload command if you run it so we have an audit trail. Also notify infra-oncall to scan S3 multipart logs for compose operations.

cory: running checks on cache now.

(5m later)
cory: found all shards in cache. part-3 checksum on disk is the good one (9f8e...). Looks like the remote compose step returned a bad object. I'll reupload and recompute manifest. Command: 
```
cat /var/build/cache/3567/shards/part-{1..7} > artifacts.tar.gz
sha256sum artifacts.tar.gz > artifacts.sha256
aws s3 cp artifacts.tar.gz s3://ci-releases/pqr789stu/artifacts.tar.gz --acl private --content-md5 $(openssl dgst -md5 -binary artifacts.tar.gz | base64)
aws s3 cp artifacts.sha256 s3://ci-releases/pqr789stu/artifacts.sha256
# update manifest
aws s3 cp manifest.json s3://ci-releases/pqr789stu/manifest.json
```

cory: reupload started and then requested a manual retry: `deploybot retry 3567 --by cory --reason "reupload from cache - chunk mismatch"`.

deploy-bot: Manual retry requested by cory for pipeline 3567. Queued on runner staging-12.

infra-oncall: scanning S3 logs now for multipart compose errors within timeframe.

shera: while retrying, let's hold on promotion. If retry succeeds, run a short smoke set (migrations dry-run + auth smoke + 1 generation request) before canary. If retry fails again, pin to v1.7.0 and file INFRA ticket.

(8m later)

deploy-bot: Pipeline 3567 retry completed with exit code 0. multipart-verify PASS. Canaries remain paused pending short smoke.

cory: kicking smoke: migrations ok, auth ok, gen sample within SLO. Posting sha256 and upload logs to release ticket for audit.

infra-oncall: S3 logs show a failed compose operation for object path during original build window; reason: transient proxy connection reset. No other compose failures across region. Filed INFRA-2401 "S3 compose proxy connection resets" assigned to networking.

shera: given clean retry and smoke, decision: promote canary after 10m watch. Add release note entry: "Hotfix: reupload of assembled artifact due to multipart compose checksum mismatch; smoke tests passed; infra investigating transient proxy resets (INFRA-2401)."

nihal: promoting canary in 10m and monitoring health/5xx for storage. If we see recurring compose/checksum incidents we will pin back to v1.7.0 and roll back.

cory: monitoring upload and download latency graphs now.

(12m later)

deploy-bot: Canary promotion completed. Release continued.

shera: closing thread for this window. Follow-up: infra to report root cause and remediation before next change window.
